Powered by a converged context engine and pre-built agent templates, RAGFlow enables developers to transform complex data into high-fidelity, production-ready AI systems with exceptional efficiency and precision.

cactus-compute/needle.readme_summary: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use and structured extraction. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on our Simple Attention Network findings, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine. On the benchmarks below, Needle 2 trades wins with other small models like FunctionGemma 270M, LFM2.5 230M and Apple FM, at 5x to 70x smaller, and 2 bits against their f16.

analysis.positioning: Needle 是一个面向微型设备（如手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人）的14MB基础模型，其第二代模型为45M参数，专注于工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取。它通过将整个模型压缩为单个14MB二进制文件，在约28MB RAM中运行完整会话，解决了在资源受限设备上部署大语言模型的难题。与FunctionGemma 270M、LFM2.5 230M和Apple FM等小模型相比，Needle 2在基准测试中互有胜负，但体积小5到70倍，且仅用2比特量化，而对手使用f16。
